limitations: Two fixed left scenes and two offsets with recorded high-level guidance are a four-case diagnostic, not autonomous100-trial or population SR.
Actual H4/4/30 also changes replanning frequency and temporal-ensemble overlap; same declared seeds do not guarantee identical initial RGB/model samples or closed-loop prefixes.
First241 gate is a verified producer receipt; the unrecorded pre-policy window is not a full independent replay.
The original SR has no extra final hold; the successful recording includes only7 final120Hz rows with zero robot contact.

All four full particle/contact/control traces and three camera videos are independently reviewed; historical earlier component/material limitations remain in immutable old receipts, not silently overwritten.
Authored collider projection and authored Cavity classification do not certify cooked PhysX surfaces or absence of rendering penetration; contact counts do not determine force/friction.
